relevance: Type-1/2/3 memory taxonomy. Type-3 (footprints, craters, film) needs an initialized ready state m-dagger of low marginal entropy, reached by a process raising joint entropy of memory plus external system. Type-2 (RAM) is time-symmetric. Critiques Albert-Loewer; analyses two-time (Brownian-bridge) conditioning under the Past Hypothesis. conclusion: Type-3 memory, and so the epistemic arrow, rests on the second law; strict necessity not proven.
